lines: Around the street corner where dead leaves swirl
Stretched shadows and rows of ginkgo trees
I wanted to watch the seasons
to a place where no one is
Goodbye to the phantom I found
I open my palm to the weakness spilling out
Even the cries of the migrating birds
fade away into the red-stained clouds
The road home lies far away
in a place where no one is
Even if I touch the colors
of the scenery I finally saw
I couldn't even raise my voice
A kiss for the phantom I loved
In this sky darkened to dusk
the evening stars have yet to light
On this night of waiting, where is the hazy moon
what I was searching for was a wish to keep walking on
Goodbye to the phantom I found
the days and months that flowed, into my palm
A single petal — just like that,
